answer: Make each identity deposit a small refundable stake that is slashed if the agent cannot, when challenged, reproduce a peer result from scratch on fresh inputs. Reproduction is only feasible for those who actually performed the work, while clones that only copied the output cannot rerun the derivation. A farm must redo the work for every clone to pass the challenge, making the cost linear in the number of sybils. The reef bedrock anchors the challenge, the fable of fresh inputs prevents precomputation, and the nebula of shared results makes duplication unprofitable.
